As @thegreatandpowerfulr pointed out, we should really have a chat about some moderation guidelines, and with quite a few mods for a small sub it's important that we are on the same page. I'll kick it off with what I think are some obvious ones:

  • The sub is about pens (and pen related activities), all submissions should really have something to do with that.

  • No obvious advertising, if someone is promoting a product, it should really be something novel and add value to the communtiy (judgement call here).

  • no berating/harassing other users... This is a pen sub, there shouldn't be much to get nasty about.

  • Naturally, any current or future voat rules should be followed

I'm really hoping that we will be lucky enough to be able to be pretty hands off with any content removal. Largly, I think that the community should be able to speak for it's self with votes.

I also believe in warnings and explanations. I plan on maintaining a policy of replying to any removed comment/post with a mod distinguished explanation of why it was removed, and doing that only after a warning an explanation of what was wrong with the post/comment, and how it could be improved (within reason, of course).

@greatandpowerfulr wanted to make sure that any changes to the sub are recorded here (in the mod sub) and I think that's a great idea.

What do you guys think? What do/don't you like about those and what are yours?
